title: Floor 3 Companion League remaining slices
description: Materialize the remaining implementation issues for Floor 3's Companion League epic from the living spec in .specify/specs/floor3-companion-league.md. Slices 1-6 and 8 have landed and slice 7 is already under review, so this graph starts at the remaining planned work to avoid duplicating existing PR work. The remaining graph moves from scaffolded to bootable, playable, completable, MVP, and released through the shared ScenarioDefinition manifest.
hard_gate: A representative seed must spawn the remaining Companion League content and reach the real win/victory condition through both the production headless runner and the visual AI Runner using the shared ScenarioDefinition manifest.
non_goals: Rank 1: numeric balance, pacing, and win-rate tuning remain HUMAN_GATE decisions.
Rank 2: already-landed slices, unrelated floors, and broad art polish are out of scope.
human_gates: HUMAN_GATE: Playtester or Game Designer must approve numeric balance, pacing, difficulty, and achievement thresholds after representative runtime evidence.

review.body: Source of truth: .specify/specs/floor3-companion-league.md and the linked Floor 3 game-design/roster documents. Human review should confirm this file still matches the remaining slice plan before closing as completed.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 9: Final Four arena chamber map generation
nodes.body:
Owner: Set Designer.

Complete the remaining Floor 3 set-piece work by adding the dedicated Final Four arena chamber generation path from the Floor 3 spec and validate it with the set-piece lab. The affinity-specific Studio motifs and Final Four set-piece definition are already authored and wired; prerequisite outside this epic file: slice 7 overworld/map work must be landed.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 10: persistent player reward track wiring
nodes.body:
Owner: Systems Engineer.

Wire Floor 3 defeated wild/trainer/Studio companions to the existing persistent player rewards path: XP gems, gold, loot, world.playerLevel, Inventory, and pickup helpers, with focused regression coverage.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 11: kept-companion persistence producer contract
nodes.body:
Owner: Producer.

Add the Floor 3 producer side of KeptCompanionContract on the floor-transition carryover channel and the end-of-floor picker hook. Floor 4+ consumption remains a separate epic concern.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 12: onboarding, starter, and poach UX surfaces
nodes.body:
Owner: UX Designer.

Implement the first Floor 3 UX group from the spec: intro/onboarding, starter choice, poach choice, and related deterministic UI/lab coverage using existing UI patterns.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 13: party HUD, roster, level-up, and combat command UX
nodes.body:
Owner: UX Designer.

Implement the second Floor 3 UX group from the spec: party HUD, roster/detail surfaces, level-up/evolution, ability command, and matchup indicator with deterministic coverage.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 14: versus intros, win/lose, overworld markers, and keep-companion UX
nodes.body:
Owner: UX Designer.

Implement the third Floor 3 UX group from the spec: versus intros, win/lose screens, overworld markers, and keep-companion picker, with deterministic visual/runtime checks.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 15: Companion League sprite generation
nodes.body:
Owner: Graphics Designer.

Generate and wire the 156 Companion form sprites for the Floor 3 roster through the approved sprite pipeline, preserving manifest integrity and floor art requirements.

nodes.title: Floor 3 Slice 16: balance pass and win-rate gate
nodes.body:
Owner: QA Engineer.

Run the Floor 3 headless win-rate evidence work from the spec without cherry-picking seeds. Verify the achievement-integrated QA path: the achievement unlocks after its measured objective, its reward can be claimed exactly once, and the resulting reward outcome is granted and asserted. Achievement thresholds and other quantitative decisions remain HUMAN_GATE decisions; broad sweeps must use GitHub infrastructure by default. Done when the headless and visual AI Runner evidence proves spawn to win/victory and the floor is ready for MVP release.
